summary: Lifeline Ventures is a Finland-based early-stage firm founded by serial entrepreneurs. Its homepage describes a sector-agnostic pre-seed and seed investor that wants to partner with founders from the very beginning, and lists recent pre-seed rounds such as Proteins.1, CRACI and Elva. The team page says founders who want to partner should email one of the partners directly at a firstname address. Check size, formal geography and a street address are not published on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: Listed on the homepage under new investments as a pre-seed round. The date is not stated.
